reproduction_boundary: The checker and raw census outputs are not distributed, so those historical aggregate runs cannot be reproduced from these eight files alone. Complete sample counts and exhaustive split maximality are omitted. Every finite fact used in the public analytical proof is instead given as an explicit integer inequality or identity. The finite square-exclusion table is an editorial expansion of the accepted small-parameter check, not a new search or stronger theorem.
